KPIs, activity and what needs attention.

webRecipes.notes: One primary CTA repeated in hero, pricing and final CTA. Real customer logos and numbers only.
Email capture above the fold; keep navigation minimal.
Specific history and real people. No mission-statement filler.
Max 70ch line length; table of contents for posts over ~800 words.
Filters become a sheet below lg.
Price, variants and add-to-cart visible without scrolling on desktop.
Show totals incl. SST and delivery before payment; FPX, DuitNow, card.
Price, beds, baths, built-up and location on every card.
Agent card with REN number and WhatsApp.
Date, venue, seats left and registration in a sticky card.
Salary range and location per role where possible.
State reply time; offer WhatsApp in Malaysia.
Always offer search and 2–3 useful links.
